slides.stem: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x) = (2x - 1)^2 - 5$. What is the value of $f(-2)$?

slides.intro: Work inside out, and keep the $-5$ for the end.
slides.trapWhy: $25$ stops at the squaring. The $-5$ outside still has to come off.

slides.title: Inside out, always
slides.body:
Nested expressions unwind from the inside: parentheses, then the exponent, then whatever waits outside.

The SAT parks tempting mid-calculation values in the choices. If your number appeared before you finished, keep going.
